notes.title: The release of our new game!
notes.notes:
We have released a new game for fans of eroticism and visual novels.
Hurry up to grab it at an extremely low discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/961700/NekoCharm/

notes.title: The first week's patch is now available!
notes.notes:
We have read your feedback and listen to it carefully.
We try to fix problems as they come, starting with the most serious.
At the moment we have added new bosses and fixed the most difficult problems with the game. 
We will continue to support and improve the game and look forward to the loyalty of the community, as well as your feedback.

notes.title: Game release!!
notes.notes:
We finally did it!
We released the game though and had to sacrifice many features. 
But don't worry, within a few weeks we will be making some major patches. 
You can also influence the development of the project, write your suggestions in the discussion!
